chunks: And whatever is in it from Ṣāliḥ ibn ʿUqbah, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Saʿdābādī, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān and Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān together, from Ṣāliḥ ibn ʿUqbah ibn Qays ibn Samʿān ibn Abī Rabīḥah, the freed slave of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family.

key_terms.جَمِيعًا: Together; indicating that two narrators jointly transmit from the same source.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I have narrated it; a transmission formula indicating receipt of the report.
key_terms.صَالِحِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ: The narrator whose transmission path is being clarified.
key_terms.مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: Freed slave or client of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ṣāliḥ ibn ʿUqbah in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the transmission chain for narrations attributed to Ṣāliḥ ibn ʿUqbah in Man lā yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It is a sanad clarification statement that identifies the intermediaries through whom the author received these reports and notes Ṣāliḥ ibn ʿUqbah’s lineage and connection as a mawlā of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.
